translationRepairs: Bing by nature was frugal; he constantly wore a cloth quilt, ate plain food, and used earthenware vessels.
Bing by nature was frugal; he constantly used a cloth quilt, ate plain food, and used earthenware vessels.
In s0011 常服布被, 服 with a quilt means using it as bedding, not wearing it as clothing; 'wore a cloth quilt' is a real misreading.
In the fourth year he was appointed grandee of the grand minister of education for directorships.
In the fourth year he was appointed Director to the Grand Minister over the Masses.
四年，拜大司徒司直 names the office 司直 under 大司徒; 'grandee … for directorships' is a garbled mistranslation of that title.
In the fourth year, he was appointed Grandee of the Grand Minister of Education for Directorships.
In the fourth year, he was appointed Si Zhi of the Grand Minister over the Masses.
The same Chinese 大司徒司直 requires the specific office Si Zhi under the Grand Minister over the Masses, not 'Grandee … for Directorships'.
Those who suffered bereavement and grief, he always waited for Dan to handle it; the village neighbors took it as normal.
Those who suffered bereavement and grief always waited for Dan to handle it; the village neighbors took it as normal.
其有遭喪憂者，輒待丹為辦 makes the bereaved the ones who wait for Dan to arrange matters; the original literal's 'he always waited for Dan' wrongly makes Dan the waiter.
In the fifth year he was appointed bearer of the brightness, superintendent of the imperial household.
In the fifth year he was appointed Superintendent of the Imperial Household (Guanglu Xun).
五年，拜光祿勛 is the office Guanglu Xun / Superintendent of the Imperial Household; 'bearer of the brightness' is an opaque false calque that should not stand beside the real title.
When Wang Mang fell and banditry flared, Du Lin fled west of the Yellow River with his brother Du Cheng, Fan Sui, Meng Ji, and others from the commandery, taking women and children along.
When Wang Mang fell and banditry flared, Du Lin fled west of the Yellow River with his brother Du Cheng, Fan Qun, Meng Ji, and others from the commandery, taking women and children along.
同郡範逡 has given name 逡 (Qūn); English Fan Sui wrongly maps the name onto 范雎 and mismatches the supplied pinyin Fàn Qūn.

When Wang Mang fell, bandits arose; Lin together with his younger brother Cheng and Fan Sui, Meng Ji, and others of the same commandery led the women and children and together sojourned west of the River.

When Wang Mang fell, bandits arose; Lin together with his younger brother Cheng and Fan Qun, Meng Ji, and others of the same commandery led the women and children and together sojourned west of the River.
Literal 範逡 must likewise be Fan Qun; Fan Sui is the same pinyin error as in the idiomatic line.
Zhang and Chen met violent ends; Xiao and Zhu fell out at the last—therefore one knows those who preserve friendship to the end are few."
Zhang and Chen came to a disastrous end in their friendship; Xiao and Zhu fell out at the last—therefore one knows those who preserve friendship to the end are few."
In the friendship catalogue 張、陳兇其終 paired with 蕭，朱隙其末, 兇其終 means their friendship ended disastrously, not merely that they 'met violent ends' as deaths.
Zhang Er and Chen Yu destroyed each other; Xiao Wangzhi and Zhu Bo fell out at the end—so few friendships stay whole."
Zhang Er and Chen Yu destroyed each other; Xiao Yu and Zhu Bo fell out at the end—so few friendships stay whole."
The set pair 蕭朱隙其末 is Xiao Yu (蕭育) and Zhu Bo, the friendship that ended in estrangement; Xiao Wangzhi is the wrong referent for 蕭 here.
Soon he was again summoned as tutor to the heir apparent; he then called the client and said, 'Your breaking off—how you underestimated Dan's meanness?'
Soon he was again summoned as tutor to the heir apparent; he then called the client and said, 'Your breaking off—how could you think Dan so petty?'
何量丹之薄也 rebukes the client for regarding Dan as petty/small-minded; 'meanness' as moral baseness misreads 薄.

Xing had once served Liu Xin as teacher; when Lin encountered him, he happily said, 'For Lin to obtain Xing and the like is indeed harmony; if Hong could obtain Lin, there would yet be something by which to enrich him.'

Xing had once taken Liu Xin as his teacher; when Lin encountered him, he happily said, 'For Lin to obtain Xing and the like is indeed harmony; if Hong could obtain Lin, there would yet be something by which to enrich him.'
興嘗師事劉歆 means Xing served Liu Xin as his teacher (studied under him); 'served Liu Xin as teacher' reverses the teacher–student relation.
He recommended Fan Sui, Zhao Bing, Shentu Gang, Niu Han of Longxi, and others; each won appointment, and talent flocked to his banner.
He recommended Fan Qun, Zhao Bing, Shentu Gang, Niu Han of Longxi, and others; each won appointment, and talent flocked to his banner.
林薦同郡範逡 again names Fan Qun; Fan Sui is the conventional English for a different figure 范雎 and cannot stand here.
Lin recommended Fan Sui, Zhao Bing, Shen Tu Gang, and Niu Han of Longxi, and others of the same sort; all were promoted and employed, and many scholars attached to him.
Lin recommended Fan Qun, Zhao Bing, Shen Tu Gang, and Niu Han of Longxi, and others of the same sort; all were promoted and employed, and many scholars attached to him.
Literal 範逡 must be Fan Qun for the same reason as the idiomatic repair.

Wei Ao still wanted his service yet meant to indulge him, and issued a proclamation: 'Du Boshan cannot be bound as a subject to the Son of Heaven nor kept as a friend by any prince—he is another Boyi and Shuqi, ashamed to eat the grain of the usurping Zhou.'

Wei Ao still wanted his service yet meant to indulge him, and issued a proclamation: 'Du Boshan cannot be bound as a subject to the Son of Heaven nor kept as a friend by any prince—he is another Boyi and Shuqi, ashamed to eat the grain of Zhou.'
恥食周粟 has only Zhou grain; 'usurping' is an interpretive insertion absent from the Chinese.
The Book of Changes says, 'Heaven aids the trustworthy'—and the text does not lie.'
The Book of Changes says, 'What people help is trustworthiness'—and there is no falsehood in this.
The quoted 人之所助者信 means what people help is trustworthiness; 'Heaven aids the trustworthy' imports the wrong Yijing half-line and leaves a broken closing quote.

I have received more honor than I deserve and a heavier charge than I can bear; I admire the minister who promoted his better alongside himself and dread the reproach of the man who hid talent—so I risk your displeasure to speak.'

I have received more honor than I deserve and a heavier charge than I can bear; privately I admire Gongshu's example of rising together, and I fear the crime of Zang Wen's stealing a place—so I risk your displeasure to speak.'
私慕公叔同升之義，懼於臧文竊位之罪 names Gongshu and Zang Wen; the idiomatic paraphrase drops those exemplar names.

Your servant Cang's glory and favor are already extreme; my burden of responsibility is deep and great; privately I admire Uncle Gong's meaning of rising together, and fear the crime of Zang Wenrong's stealing a place; I dare, holding my foolish blindness, to offend against stern prohibitions.'

Your servant Cang's glory and favor are already extreme; my burden of responsibility is deep and great; privately I admire Gongshu's meaning of rising together, and fear the crime of Zang Wen's stealing a place; I dare, holding my foolish blindness, to offend against stern prohibitions.'
公叔 is Gongshu, not 'Uncle Gong'; 臧文 is Zang Wen, not the invented 'Zang Wenrong'.
The emperor pardoned Xu Kuang but still demoted Wu Liang to magistrate of Jiuqiu.
The emperor pardoned Xu Kuang but still demoted Wu Liang to magistrate of Jiqiu.
即丘長 is chief/magistrate of Jiqiu (即丘); Jiuqiu misreads the toponym.
Although the emperor pardoned Kuang, he still demoted Liang leftward to be chief of Jiuqiu.
Although the emperor pardoned Kuang, he still demoted Liang leftward to be chief of Jiqiu.
Literal 即丘 must likewise be romanized Jiqiu, not Jiuqiu.
Whenever seated in great deliberation, he always relied on the classics, did not hope for imperial intent or echo vulgar opinion, in order to seek timely praise.
Whenever seated in great deliberation, he always relied on the classics, and did not trim to imperial intent or echo vulgar opinion so as to angle for temporary praise.
不希旨偶俗，以僥時譽 refuses trimming to court fashion in order to angle for temporary praise; the original purpose clause wrongly makes seeking praise the goal of the refusal.

Moreover, former chief of Anyi Mao Yi personally practiced yielding and modesty; compared to being summoned he declined illness; the wind of purity and simplicity, the eastern provinces praise as benevolent.'
Moreover, former chief of Anyi Mao Yi personally practiced yielding and modesty; whenever summoned he declined citing illness; the eastern provinces praise his pure and simple manner as benevolent.'
比征辭病 means whenever summoned he declined citing illness; 'compared to being summoned he declined illness' is an unnatural miscalque.

The next year, the emperor on eastern tour passed Rencheng, thereupon visited Jun's house, ordered bestowal of a Director of the Secretariat's salary for the rest of his life; therefore people of the time called him the "commoner Director of the Secretariat."'

The next year, the emperor on eastern tour passed Rencheng, thereupon visited Jun's house, ordered bestowal of a Director of the Secretariat's salary for the rest of his life; therefore people of the time called him the "commoner Director of the Secretariat."
The nickname quotation 白衣尚書 closes cleanly; the literal English adds a stray trailing single quote after the closing quotation marks.
He was twice promoted to junior minister of Changle and commandant of the guards.
He was successively transferred to junior minister of Changle and commandant of the guards.
再遷長樂少府、衛尉 marks successive transfers into those two offices; 'twice promoted to … and …' wrongly suggests two promotions into both posts jointly.
He died the same year and was canonized as Marquis Zhong—'the Loyal.'
He died the same year and was given the posthumous title Marquis Zhong—'the Loyal.'
溢曰忠侯 (for 謚) grants a secular posthumous marquis title; 'canonized' overstates that as religious canonization.
Dayi swan took flight, seen as a model for the Prince of Dongping.
Dayi took flight like a swan, and was seen as a model for the Prince of Dongping.
大儀鵠發 is Dayi taking flight like a swan; 'Dayi swan' wrongly fuses the simile into a compound name.
